description: Montgomery Central Appraisal District. No bulk file URL could be retrieved. See docs/registry/sources/tx-montgomery-cad.md.

sources.notes: mcad-tx.org is the same True Prodigy 'Public Portal' single-page app as hidalgoad.org and www.dentoncad.com: an empty shell without JavaScript, no robots.txt rules. A search index lists mcad-tx.org/appraisal-data-exports (certified roll zips for 2019 to 2026, a 2026 certified roll in JSON, a 2026 preliminary roll, export layouts as PDF, spreadsheet and JSON) and mcad-tx.org/gis-data (parcels, ownership, subdivisions via the Montgomery County Open Data site), but no file URL was seen and no terms were readable. A City of Houston ArcGIS service (geohwp.houstontx.gov Parcels_Current layer 3 'Current MCAD Parcels', fields STATECLASS, OWNER, ADDRESS, YEAR_BUILT, IMPR_SQ_FT) mirrors MCAD parcels but was last updated 2025-03-27 and is a third-party copy, so it was not used.
